# form.addFileField

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.5.5</span></div>

Add a file field to the current form.

```lua
form.addFileField(line, rect, path, fileType, getValue, setValue)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `line` | FormLine | yes | the line where the field should be added |
| `rect` | Rect | yes | the coordinates |
| `path` | string | yes | the files directory |
| `fileType` | string | yes | the files type: "txt" for text files, support .txt, "image" for image files, support .png, .jpg, .bmp, "lua" for lua script files, support .lua, .luac, "frk" for frk files, support .frk, "frsk" for frsk files, support .frsk, "bin" for binary files, support .bin, "audio" for audio files, support .wav, "video" for video files, support .mp4, "hex" for hex files, support .hex, "i18n" for translation files, support .i18n, "csv" for log files, support .csv, "md" for markdown files, support .md, followed by "+ext" to see the files with their extension |
| `getValue` | function | yes | the function which will return the current file name |
| `setValue` | function | yes | the function which will be called on file change |

## Returns

The new field

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
form.addFileField(line, nil, "/audio/en/system", "audio", function() return filename end, function(newValue) filename = newValue end)
```

## Used in

- [tool-form](../../examples/official/tool-form.md)
